setup_reference.purpose: Complete reproducible setup for the validated Mario playable and cutscene replacement mod.

tools.astc_encoder_note: Available in PATH; known executable also at %USERPROFILE%/Documents/cli_tools/astcenc-avx2.exe.

submesh_5.geometry_normals_uv_topology: Import directly from the current FBX.
submesh_5.weights: Remove every FBX influence and rig every stored vertex only to semantic bone_107 at weight 1.0.
submesh_5.deformation: Neutralize auxiliary vertex streams; B00A, B00B, and B00C are purged globally so no eye morph, UV animation, or other face transform remains.

submesh_6.geometry_normals_uv_topology: Import directly from the current FBX.
submesh_6.weights: Use nearest original target vertex weights, retain at most the two strongest influences, normalize to an exact float32 sum of 1.0, and use bone_107 only for invalid-weight fallback.

submesh_7.geometry_normals_uv_topology: Import directly from the current FBX.
submesh_7.weights: Preserve FBX weights without nearest-original remapping, truncation, redistribution, or normalization; abort unless every vertex already has at most two usable influences and their sum is within 0.0001 of 1.0.

submesh_14.geometry_normals_uv_topology: Import directly from the current FBX.
submesh_14.weights: Use nearest original target vertex weights with the two-strongest/exact-sum rule and bone_107 invalid-weight fallback.
submesh_14.deformation: Do not neutralize its auxiliary streams because the established hat replacement is already correct.

geometry_storage_rules.vertex_count: Abort the entire import if any FBX replacement has more vertices than its original target mesh.
geometry_storage_rules.padding: For replaced non-hat meshes with fewer vertices, pad inactive tail vertices and skins to the target's original stored vertex count.
geometry_storage_rules.buffers: Keep original index, skin, and vertex buffer addresses whenever payloads fit; relocate only an independently oversized stream into target-slot B005 free space.
geometry_storage_rules.indices: Use 16-bit triangle indices and abort if any index is outside the source vertex count.
geometry_storage_rules.uv_conversion: Store game V as 1.0 minus Blender V.
geometry_storage_rules.unknown_vertex_fields: Copy from the nearest original target vertex before overwriting imported position, normal, and UV fields.

facial_deformation_rules.auxiliary_streams: Zero the third-to-fourth B004 auxiliary range and fill the fourth stream with FFFFFFFFFF7FFF7F sentinels for submeshes 5, 6, and 7.

texture_rules.source: Use hash-named PNG files in this directory.
texture_rules.redirects: Read textures.json first. If both its key and value hashes exist in Global, redirect all matching B006 material references and skip that PNG replacement.
texture_rules.fallback: If a redirect key or value is unavailable in Global, retain the source hash and perform regular PNG replacement.
texture_rules.allocation_limit: Encoded texture data must never exceed the original texture allocation; rescale or compress harder if necessary.
texture_rules.diffuse: Encode through the established ASTC path with eight mip levels.
texture_rules.normal_maps: Use the correct native normal-map format; never encode BC5 normal data as diffuse ASTC data.

required_validation: Validate all 16 mesh replacements and every triangle index bound.
Validate the configured per-mesh weight invariants.
Validate texture allocation sizes and material redirects.
Reopen the emitted archive and byte-compare decompressed sections 0, 52, 54, and 65.
Copy to the configured Yuzu ROMFS only after the build succeeds.
Regenerate the compact installer from the exact successful build and accept it only when installed global.dict and global.data SHA-256 hashes match that build.
